name: ShoppingCart
description: Mortar shopping cart: bag lines with image, options, price, stock, a quantity select and a remove button labelled with the product name; focus moves to the next line after a removal. Shows an empty state when there are no items. Optional summary column (e.g. an OrderSummary with estimates) and related products shown as a ProductList.

props.items: CartItem[] ({ id: string; name: string; href: string; price: string; quantity: number; image: { src: string; alt: string }; meta?: string; stock?: string })
props.label: string
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 3; each line's product name and the empty state's title)
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode } (default "Your bag is empty")
props.summary: ReactNode (beside the lines when wide, below them when narrow; e.g. an OrderSummary)
props.related: { title: string; products: ProductCard[]; headingLevel?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2; product names one level below) } (suggestions under the bag, also shown when it is empty)

contract.usage: Import { ShoppingCart } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
